in_marathi.name: Lr
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। LR is a combination of two letters, each of which has its own meaning and significance in Hindu culture. L represents the Sun, a symbol of power, strength, and illumination. R represents the Moon, a symbol of peace, tranquility, and nurturing energy. Together, LR signifies a person who radiates both the fiery power of the Sun and the soothing energy of the Moon.
